subject: Late reply...
author: ZombieTron
body:
Sorry for the late reply!

Some of the challenges are pretty long, and you would need to run the ones in the same place on the map together to cut down the time spent driving between challenges. But, if you work out a route and have a crew who can complete them all quickly I can imagine it can definitely be done in one day... not sure how long it would actually take tho!

I am not mad enough to try!

I would like to know how you got on with it tho, if you did try it!!! 🙂
